cityClasses.title: Witches Regatta SUP Event
cityClasses.address: Tempe Town Lake Boat Marina (north shore), 550 Tempe Town Lake, Tempe, AZ 85281
cityClasses.note: Our annual Halloween paddleboard gathering on Tempe Town Lake — wear your best witch or warlock cloak and float the lake as a coven. We'll meet on the hill by the boat marina on the north side of the lake. It's wildly popular and capacity is limited, so book early.

cityClasses.title: Witches Regatta — Board + T-Shirt Bundle
cityClasses.address: Tempe Town Lake Boat Marina (north shore), 550 Tempe Town Lake, Tempe, AZ 85281
cityClasses.note: Need a board? This bundle pairs an inflatable paddleboard rental with a Witches Regatta t-shirt so you can show up empty-handed and still float the lake in style. Same date and meeting spot as the Regatta — the hill by the boat marina on the north side of Tempe Town Lake. Capacity is limited, so book early.

cityClasses.title: Salt River Paddleboarding Outing
cityClasses.note: A guided paddleboard outing on the lower Salt River — glide past saguaros, cottonwoods and the wild horses on calm desert water. We meet in northeast Mesa (the Walgreens at 3624 N Power Rd) and carpool to the river together, then float downstream for about 2.5 hours. Suitable for all activity levels — you don't have to stand up; you're welcome to stay seated and float the whole way down. Boards and guide included, and you'll paddle alongside our friendly golden retriever — an introvert's dream and the perfect companion (and conversation starter) on the water. More details will be sent to you upon registration.
